data.name: Chilling Infusion
data.description: Element water; Type substance infusion; Level 5; Burn 3 Associated Blasts blizzard, cold, ice Saving Throw Fortitude negates Your kinetic blast chills your foes to the bone, making their movements sluggish. Whenever an infused blast deals cold damage to a foe, that foe is staggered for 1 round.
